Third alpha: colour customisation and better office hours.

## New
- **Subject colours:** give any subject its own colour (Settings → Subject colors). It applies to every timetable and to PDF/XLSX exports. Subject colours win over the school's colours.
- **Fill or border, per state:** for exams, substitutions and cancellations, choose whether the special colour fills the whole lesson or only colours its border (e.g. exam = border, cancellation = whole lesson).

## Changed
- **Office hours** list all teachers, sorted alphabetically, each with their slots by date. "Only my class" narrows the list.
- Substitutions now default to **border** mode, so lessons keep their subject colour. Switch to "Fill" in the settings for the old look.

## Install
**Android:** download the `.apk` and open it. It updates the previous alpha in place.

**iPhone / iPad:** sideload the unsigned `.ipa` with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io).

**Web:** unpack `…-web-linux-x64.tar.gz` and run `./bbu_server`, or use the Dockerfile from the repo (see `WEB.md`).
